Name: (CP) Better Sweet Gem Berry Bush by Luna
Author: LunaGlaze
Description:
Are you bothered by the fact that the seeds of Sweet Gem Berry are hard to obtain and cannot be harvested repeatedly? Are you bothered by the fact that Sweet Gem Berry resembles stone more than fruit? Are you worried that allowing Gem Berry to regrow directly is too unbalanced?
[size=4][b]Then this mod must be for you![/b][/size]
_______________________________

[b][size=3]Content|内容:[/size][/b]
Added a new seed (Sweet Gem Berry Bush Seed) with a recipe unlocked after reaching Farming Level 10. It is a variant and trellis crop upgrade of the Rare Seed, with the same growth cycle, but can yield multiple harvests of Sweet Gem Berry.
添加一种新的种子（宝石甜莓灌木种子），可以在耕种等级10后解锁配方。其是稀有种子的棚架作物变体和升级，具有相同的生长周期，但可以多次收获宝石甜莓。

This mod has a settings option, you can freely set the re-growth period of the Sweet Gem Berry Bush (default is 18). In addition, this mod has an additional setting (enabled by default) that can set the Sweet Gem Berry to be a fruit, thus making it possible to make Wine and Jelly.
本Mod具有设置选项，你可以自由设置宝石甜莓灌木的重生长周期（默认为18）。此外本Mod有一个额外的设置（默认开启），可以将宝石甜莓设置为水果，从而使得制作果酒和果酱成为可能。

You can choose the crafting difficulty of the Sweet Gem Berry Bush Seed through the configuration, and even turn off the addition of the new Sweet Gem Berry crop and just use the function that sets Sweet Gem Berry as a fruit. You can also choose to make it a non-passable trellis crop or a passable regular regrowable crop.
你可以通过配置选择宝石甜莓灌木种子的制作难度，甚至关闭对新宝石甜莓作物的添加，只是使用将宝石甜莓设置为水果的功能。你也可以选择将其设置为不可通过的棚架作物或可通过的普通可重生长作物。

[b]Using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to set it.
使用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]通用模组配置菜单[/url]来对其进行设置。[/b]
